newsitem.title: EGYPT: Egypt shares hit 12th record high.
newsitem.headline: Egypt shares hit 12th record high.

text.p: Egyptian shares continued their uptrend on Monday, hitting the 12th record high in a row.
The Capital Market Authority (CMA) all-share index rose 7.31 points from Sunday to close at 387.92 points on turnover of 46.62 million pounds ($13.71 million).
Demand for cement and milling shares remain strong.
Amriyah Cement was the day's most active share, accounting for about 7.69 million pounds. But the share closed down 1.40 pounds at 85.0.

Helwan Portland Cement was the third most active share with shares worth 4.66 million pounds changing hands. It ended unchanged at 80 pounds. Suez Cement closed up 3.00 pounds at 75.00 in 3.30 million pounds worth of trade.
Egyptian Tora Portland Cement fell 1.00 to close at 90.00 pounds.
The millers, which came back on the list of most active shares after a short disappearance, dominated trade together with the cement sector. The only exception was two financial firms.
Upper Egypt Flour Mills closed up 4.92 pounds after 2.70 million pounds worth of shares were traded.
Central and West Delta Flour Mills and East Delta Flour Mills also rose 6.28 and 4.51 pounds respectively.
Watany Bank of Egypt, the second most acitve, rose 3.15 pounds, when shares worth 6.49 million were traded.
The index for openly traded firms rose to 639.56 from 620.66 points on Sunday and the index for rarely traded "closed" firms rose to 257.66 from 254.65..
Out of the 77 shares traded, 50 gained, 11 lost and 16 ended the day unchanged.
